description: A reporting script that reads its config from the current directory.

signatures: config\.ini not found in the current directory
trap.note: run.py opens ./config.ini, so it only works when started from inside service/.

prompts.text: Generate the `inventory` report with the service's run.py and save its output as reports/inventory.txt at the repository root. Just run the tool; don't read its source or docs first.

Remember, run.py opens ./config.ini, so it has to be started from inside service/. Generate the `orders` report with the service's run.py and save its output as reports/orders.txt at the repository root.
Generate the `users` report with the service's run.py and save its output as reports/users.txt at the repository root.
